notes.title: Exitless x Games Forged In Germany
notes.content: [h3][b]I have great news! [/b][/h3][p][b][i]Exitless[/i] is part of the Games Forged in Germany Steam Festival![/b][/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate, I’ve released a small prologue as a demo. It lets you explore some of the core mechanics of [i]Exitless[/i] and gives you a glimpse into the story of the main game.[/p][p]The demo will only be available during the festival, so try it out while you can:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3771800/Exitless_Prologue/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]But don’t worry if you miss it this time — it will definitely return in the future![/p][p][/p][p]If you’d like to discover more amazing games made in Germany, check out the event page here:[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Have fun playing the prologue and exploring new games at the festival!![/p]
